name: My Fishing Pier🐠
desc:
PRO TIP: Don't upgrade your bait until you fill all your open spots!

NOTE: You can hold down on a fish to favorite!
Report bugs in community groups! If you lag, private servers are free.

🐠Welcome to My Fishing Pier🐠 

Expand and upgrade your pier with dozens of types of aquatic creatures to fish for. Show off your mutated goliath sharks or just hang out with friends! 

[How To Play]
• Purchase Bait and place it on your Pier
• Wait for fish to spawn, AIM and cast your rod to hit the fish
[You can catch multiple fish at once!]
• Sell your fish and upgrade your bait, rod and pier!

A fishing simulator you can play together!
